Our Heritage in Ahilyanagar

Authentic Maharashtrian recipes,
flawless execution

It began in 1998 in Ahilyanagar with traditional homemade Maharashtrian delicacies. Today, our mobile kitchen setup travels across Ahilyanagar, Pune, Sambhajinagar, Nashik, and across Maharashtra.

We specialize in pure vegetarian Maharashtrian & multi-cuisine catering, using fresh spices ground daily, pure ghee, and strict FSSAI hygiene standards.
